fuel.nodata_policy: Source zero and masked/unrecognized classes remain unknown; never substitute measured fuel
fuel.resampling: GDAL NEAREST independently on classes, source validity and footprint; no categorical smoothing

generated_assumptions: 500 m metric grid with outward alignment from retained bbox; no exact episode-polygon clipping
Study envelope mask uses cell centres; aligned padding is retained in raster outputs
Below -1000 is a diagnostic triage threshold, not authenticated nodata or an elevation repair
All terrain cells remain ineligible, including cells without diagnostic flags

grid.alignment: Outward rounding to EPSG:25830 coordinate multiples of 500 m
grid.envelope_mask_rule: Cell centre inside retained study bbox; padding remains explicit
grid.envelope_origin: Retained terrain acquisition bbox, not an exact episode AOI polygon

limitations: No terrain elevation, slope or aspect is emitted. Earlier 25 m averaging may have spread unknown sentinels.
Zero terrain suspect flags do not establish valid heights; MAX considers overlapping source pixels only.
Pre-fire collection claim is retained from cached metadata; authentic nodata, units and datum remain unresolved.
Later terrain publication does not establish information available to actors during the incident.
EFFIS citation 2017 and source filename FuelMap2000 do not verify vegetation observation epoch.
Nearest sampling at 500 m is not area-majority fuel or subcell composition; unsampled source gaps may be missed.
Fuel classes are not measured loads, moisture, treatments or validated engine parameters.
All actor, simulator, physics and historical replay usage remains false; no runtime integration occurs.
output_inventory_scope: Six raster artifacts; audit.json excludes its own recursive hash

remaining_gates.event_time_actor_availability: Establish information availability at event time and authorize actor inputs.
remaining_gates.fuel_historical_state: Verify vegetation observation epoch and applicability to September 2021 local fuel state.
remaining_gates.fuel_physics_parameters: Validate fuel model mapping, loads and live/dead moisture; class codes alone do not supply these.
remaining_gates.runtime_and_replay_validation: Explicitly integrate and validate simulator inputs and historical replay in separate work.
remaining_gates.terrain_nodata_and_overview_semantics: Authenticate producer nodata and overview/averaging semantics; plausibility masks cannot release quarantine.
remaining_gates.terrain_uncontaminated_elevation: Reacquire and validate uncontaminated terrain before supplying any physics-ready elevation.
remaining_gates.terrain_vertical_reference: Verify vertical units and datum from authoritative metadata.

terrain.collection_epoch_claim: REDIAM May2023 bulletin states collection captured July2020-May2021

diagnostics.flag_rule: Source-invalid, nonfinite, declared nodata or below -1000; generated triage only

terrain.mask_policy: terrain_valid_mask is zero everywhere regardless of plausibility or source mask
terrain.resampling: GDAL MAX on generated binary diagnostic flags only; no elevation resampling or interpolation
